yt_posts.body:
Kaspa itself has not had its real explosion yet.

That line reads like cope until you look at what actually happens when liquidity comes back into this market.

It does not go hunting for the best technology. It goes hunting for the names it already recognizes. Recognition matters more than activity. Low volume today is not the same thing as no potential tomorrow, and every cycle proves it again.

Look at what just happened with the memes everybody wrote off. I called Tutorial near the bottom and it ran 94x. Then it looked rugged, the chart went vertical the wrong way, and every influencer moved on. It printed another 130x after that. Pippin went completely silent in August of last year and did 85x in January, in the middle of a bear market. I sold Velvet at the top after a 58x and just bought it back 630 percent below where I sold it.

Now apply that to Kaspa.

$KAS is sitting around 2.7 cents, ranked 85 by market cap, roughly 764 million dollars of value on a fair launched proof of work chain that is a fully implemented GhostDAG. No presale, no insider allocation, no venture unlock schedule waiting to dump on you. And the KRC20 ecosystem underneath it, Kaspy and Kappy and Kroak and Kasper the Ghost and Conan, is sitting in exactly the same place those memes were sitting right before they ran.

The people calling all of it dead in August are the same people who will be bidding it in October.

Most of my money went into Kaspa way above here and I have not sold a single coin, because nothing about why I bought it has changed. The chain still does what nothing else does. The supply is still fair. The names are still known.

When the money comes back it will not read whitepapers. It will read tickers it has seen before.

So tell me: if Kaspa never gets its explosion this cycle, do you keep stacking, or do you tap out?

Hit like and subscribe if you want to be early on the next one instead of hearing about it after it runs.

yt_posts.topic: October: the transfer of wealth from the people who sold
yt_posts.body_style: who-sold-what receipt chain into a forward call
yt_posts.engagement_question: If we are green through September, are you buying, or are you still holding out for 40k?
yt_posts.body:
The people who sold in November are the same people who are going to buy in October.

I have been watching this set up for eleven months and it is finally close enough to see clearly.

Go back and look at who actually sold through last November, December and January. It was wallets holding between one and a thousand Bitcoin. The individuals and the institutions holding more than a thousand were not selling. It was the guy with twenty or fifty thousand dollars of crypto who liquidated everything, the Bitcoin, the alts and the memes, and told himself he would buy it all back cheaper in October.

They dumped at 100k, 90k and 85k. They are still sitting there waiting for 40k.

Bitcoin cleared 80,000 this week for the first time since May, with a high of 81,235. For the October bottom thesis to survive from here, we have to break the support that just got built, lose 57k, and then keep falling all the way to 40k, and do all of it inside a handful of weeks. That does not happen without something genuinely catastrophic, and a stock market retracement does not count, because everybody is already expecting one.

Here is what I think happens instead. October prints hard. The headlines start. Every influencer starts talking about crypto again, including the fitness guy and the lawnmower guy. And that crowd FOMOs back in at 110k and 120k, into alts that have already doubled, holding less of everything than they started with.

That is the transfer of wealth. It is not a metaphor. It is just the people who held taking size off the people who did not.

And if a black swan does land in October, watch what happens. The four year cycle zombies will eat those red candles alive. They have been waiting all year to buy that exact dip.

I am not calling a cycle top. I am saying the window where this stuff is still cheap is measured in weeks now, not quarters.

So tell me: if we are green through September, are you buying, or are you still holding out for 40k?

Hit like and subscribe if you want the macro read before it turns into a headline.
